title: Dim lights for the last hour.
subtitle: Circadian guardrail
rationale: Use darkness as the evening signal instead of asking willpower to shut the day down.

evidence.summary: Light exposure is a primary circadian input; evening dimming supports sleep timing.

sources.label: Evening light and circadian outcomes review

indications: Bright overhead lighting stays on until bedtime.
Sleep onset is slow even after screens are off.
